variants.name: 75 ml
variants.about_this_item:
Cliny toothpaste for dogs and cats: whitens and strengthens tooth enamel, removes plaque and tartar, freshens breath, soothes inflammation and strengthens the gums.

  • Silver ions — antibacterial action
  • Panthenol — helps the oral mucosa heal
  • Calcium lactate — saturates the enamel with calcium and makes teeth more resistant to acids
  • Round chalk particles gently whiten the enamel
  • Papain dissolves plaque and reduces gum bleeding
variants.feeding_instructions: Moisten a toothbrush, apply some paste, let your pet taste it, then brush the teeth with circular movements. Brush 2–3 times a week for 2–3 minutes. The paste does not foam, needs no rinsing and is safe if swallowed. Give fresh drinking water afterwards.
